verdicts.verify_by: cd misc/gnopreview && replace sortedKeys' body with `return slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(m))`, go test ./... and read the failure lines
verdicts.tldr: the one difference DeepEqual catches at plan_test.go:144 is the one %v cannot print
verdicts.details: plan_test.go:143 asserts Realms with reflect.DeepEqual, which beyond element equality buys exactly one thing over slices.Equal: it separates a nil Realms from an empty one. That separation is load-bearing because Plan.Realms carries `json:"realms"` with no omitempty (plan.go:73), so nil marshals into preview.json as "realms":null and []string{} as []. Four table cases pin wantRealms to []string{}, so nil-vs-empty is the failure mode those cases exist to catch, and line 144 prints it with %v: both sides render as []. Fix: print the Realms mismatch with %#v, one character, which turns `Realms = []; want []` into `Realms = []string(nil); want []string{}`.
verdicts.evidence: In a scratch worktree at ecf7af0, sortedKeys' body replaced with slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(m)) (maps imported), `go test ./...` in misc/gnopreview: `--- FAIL: TestBuildPlan/nothing_relevant` / `plan_test.go:144: Realms = []; want []`, the same line for gnoweb_alone, quarantined_packages_never_appear and tests_and_filetests_do_not_trigger_a_preview. Same probe with the verb flipped to %#v on that one Errorf: `plan_test.go:144: Realms = []string(nil); want []string{}` on all four. Baseline green before both. misc/gnopreview does not exist at the merge base, so there is nothing to run there.
